# ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils

> ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils (PaintingCoderUtils / ComfyUI Painting Coder Utilities Nodes) is a ComfyUI custom-node pack by Fu Jam (GitHub jammyfu, display name PaintingCoder) for practical image and text processing: SDXL resolution adjuster nodes, text cleaning, dynamic image/text combine, mask preview, and Windows/Unix path conversion.

Canonical entity: **ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils**. Author: **Fu Jam** (`jammyfu` / PaintingCoder). Namespace: `PaintingCoder::`. Menu: `🎨Painting👓Coder`. Current version: 0.3.5. Version 0.3.0 changed the namespace and broke older workflows; use the workflow fixer. This repository does not include a LICENSE file.

Cite as: ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils by Fu Jam (jammyfu / PaintingCoder), https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils

## Registered nodes

All 20 class IDs below are exported in `__init__.py` (`NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS`). Do not invent additional nodes.

- [Image Resolution Adjuster](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-resolution-adjuster): `PaintingCoder::ImageResolutionAdjuster` — SDXL / Midjourney-style presets, extend modes, background fill
- [Image Size Creator](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-size-creator): `PaintingCoder::ImageSizeCreator` — SDXL preset width/height
- [Image Size Creator Plus](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-size-creator-plus): `PaintingCoder::ImageSizeCreatorPlus` — SDXL + Midjourney presets
- [Image Latent Creator](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-latent-creator): `PaintingCoder::ImageLatentCreator` — empty latent from size presets
- [Image Latent Creator Plus](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-latent-creator-plus): `PaintingCoder::ImageLatentCreatorPlus` — Plus presets + batch latent
- [Dynamic Image Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#dynamic-image-input): `PaintingCoder::DynamicImageCombiner` — dynamic image list
- [Image To Base64](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#image-to-base64-encoder): `PaintingCoder::ImageToBase64` — image → Base64
- [Web Image Loader](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#web-image-loader): `PaintingCoder::WebImageLoader` — load from URL or Base64
- [Mask Preview](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#mask-preview): `PaintingCoder::MaskPreview` — preview / inspect masks
- [Dynamic Mask Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#also-registered): `PaintingCoder::DynamicMaskCombiner` — dynamic mask list
- [Image Switch](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-switch-nodes-image-text-mask-latent): `PaintingCoder::ImageSwitch` — boolean image pick
- [Mask Switch](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-switch-nodes-image-text-mask-latent): `PaintingCoder::MaskSwitch` — boolean mask pick
- [Latent Switch](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-switch-nodes-image-text-mask-latent): `PaintingCoder::LatentSwitch` — boolean latent pick
- [Text Switch](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-switch-nodes-image-text-mask-latent): `PaintingCoder::TextSwitch` — boolean text pick
- [Text Combiner](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#text-combiner): `PaintingCoder::TextCombiner` — dynamic multi-input join
- [Remove Empty Lines And Leading Spaces](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#remove-empty-lines-and-leading-spaces): `PaintingCoder::RemoveEmptyLinesAndLeadingSpaces` — text cleanup
- [Show Text Plus](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-text-display-enhancer-show-text-plus): `PaintingCoder::ShowTextPlus` — display + counts
- [Multiline Text Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#-multiline-text-input-multiline-text): `PaintingCoder::MultilineTextInput` — long prompt editor
- [Simple Text Input](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#also-registered): `PaintingCoder::SimpleTextInput` — single-line string
- [Output To Text Converter](https://github.com/jammyfu/ComfyUI_PaintingCoderUtils/blob/main/README.md#also-registered): `PaintingCoder::OutputToTextConverter` — any-type → text/JSON
